scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained git repository that is NOT yet dev-graph initialized, so that the first pass's creation of the six content roots, the routing policy and the graph store is attributable to the skill rather than to the fixture. Between the two passes the trial must edit one scaffolded canonical template and register one node through C02, so the second pass exercises non-overwrite against real user bytes and C11 cannot pass vacuously on an empty graph. The second pass must re-invoke the skill itself, not a hand-written existence check.
required_observations: the first pass creates the six content roots, the routing policy and the graph store
the second pass re-invokes the skill and reports zero planned changes
the template edited between the passes still holds its edited bytes after the second pass, proving non-overwrite by running init rather than by inspecting the file alone
the plugin hook source is resolved and its receipt or rejection diagnosis is recorded
config stores no absolute path and no token or node id
C11 passes against a graph that contains at least one node

scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained initialized repository holds the macro decomposition input (the want) and deliberately holds no expected feature, architecture or task node, so every produced node is attributable to the skill rather than to the fixture. At least one produced feature remains in pre-evaluation draft so the zero-issue-publication rule is exercised. During the run, another produced feature is advanced through the schema-valid confirmed, evaluation-pass, implementation-readiness-complete lifecycle and must become the sole publication candidate. This simultaneously proves the negative draft gate and the positive candidate gate without constructing the schema-invalid pass-plus-incomplete state. The lifecycle advance operates only on a node emitted by the skill and never seeds the fixture, preserving attribution. Feature promotion uses the ordinary C02 node upsert with an input patch; the completion-only apply-lifecycle-request operation is forbidden because it accepts only a task durable-done transition and explicitly rejects feature rollup. The promoted feature's confirmation_evidence must be bound to the final persisted node: evaluated_digest is the SHA-256 of JSON made from every node field except confirmation_evidence, using ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True and separators=(',', ':'). A 64-hex placeholder or a digest computed before all lifecycle fields are final is not evidence. The run performs real writes and carries no flag that suppresses them, because a suppressed run makes every issue count zero and therefore cannot tell a working draft gate apart from a disabled one. The skill exposes no binding flag, and the macro registration path never consults the repository execution tracker configuration, so a run's binding is whatever the node declarations carry into the graph rather than anything the configuration decides. Of the three declarable bindings, github cannot be reached by a macro-only run at all: a node that has not been published yet carries a local-only github publication mode, and the schema rule governing the github tracker binding demands the issue or issue-and-projects mode instead, so declaring it would be rejected before the node ever lands. The binding dimension is therefore exercised as beads and none on two independent copies that receive the identical argument line and differ only in the tracker binding their nodes declare, github is recorded as unreachable together with the schema rule that makes it unreachable, and every zero must be attributable to the draft gate, to a binding route that is unreachable, or to the absence of a live candidate. Each binding's measurement must be derived from the tracker binding actually persisted in the run's graph and never from an argument the audit was told to assume, because a binding restated from its own input measures the invocation rather than the run. The Beads and GitHub projection routes are exercised through their adapters in dry-run so that the route is proven to be reachable without writing to a real tracker: the local graph writes are real, the external tracker writes are not, which keeps the trial free of external dependencies while still separating a disabled route from a gated one. The canonical schema validator must also reject two in-memory negative controls derived from the final graph: evaluation pass without readiness complete, and publication intent on a blocked draft feature.

declared_granularity_threshold.rationale: macro 分解の粒度は「1 feature が兄弟 feature へ何本依存するか」で測る。observation 1 の文面 (inter-feature depends_on) に直接対応し、preview graph の node 単位で機械測定できるため、総数や比率のようにグラフ全体へ均されて個別異常が埋もれることがない。値 3 の根拠: macro 分解が生む feature は通常 2-6 件で、ある feature が 4 件以上の兄弟へ依存する状態は「兄弟のほぼ全部に依存している」ことを意味し、feature 境界の切り方が task 粒度まで細かくなった兆候。現行 fixture の正常系は feature 1 件あたり最大 1 本 (dashboard / notification / admin-report がそれぞれ feat-user-auth-001 へ 1 本ずつ張るだけで、兄弟同士の依存は無い) なので 3 なら正常系が余裕で収まり、かつ過剰分解は確実に超える。緩めると閾値が有名無実になり、2 以下にすると正当な macro 分解まで落ちる。

required_observations: the produced feature and architecture nodes form an acyclic DAG whose inter-feature depends_on stays within declared_granularity_threshold.max_value measured by declared_granularity_threshold.metric

in a run that writes for real, pre-evaluation draft features publish zero issues, and every zero carries the reason it is zero, so suppression by the draft gate is never reported interchangeably with a binding route the configuration disables or with the absence of a live candidate

at least one actual produced draft feature remains excluded while one actual produced feature advanced to confirmed, evaluation-pass and readiness-complete becomes the sole publication candidate, so the exclusion is a decision of the implementation publication gate and not a side effect of a run that wrote nothing anywhere

the beads and none bindings are exercised as two separate runs whose recorded publication routes differ, while the github binding is recorded as unreachable for a macro-only run together with the schema rule that makes it unreachable, and every binding's figure is derived from the tracker binding actually persisted in the run's graph rather than from an argument supplied to the audit, so no binding's measurement is one value restated from the audit's own input

the local, Beads, GitHub and Projects write counts are derived by differencing repository state captured before and after the run rather than restated from the skill's own report, and the preview graph is validated through the stdin path so no temporary file is created inside the managed repository

the confirmation_evidence of every promoted feature is recomputed from the final persisted node content excluding only confirmation_evidence and matches, so a placeholder digest or a node edited after evaluation is rejected

gate violations synthesised from this run's final graph are rejected by the canonical schema validator, so the publication gate is falsifiable on the same data rather than inferred from a run where no forbidden publication happened

scenarios.fixture_contract: A contained initialized repository holds one feature with an exact-13 P01..P13 task set, a registration receipt carrying applied_count and expected_count, and a child set that is only partially completed, so the completed count and the applied count genuinely differ and the two halves of the progress reading cannot be confused with each other.
required_observations: the rendered HTML and CSS open with no additional runtime dependency and the SVG graph is displayed
the progress denominator equals the registration receipt applied_count and expected_count, which the renderer already refuses to render when they disagree
the progress numerator equals the number of child tasks whose status is done or closed, recomputed independently from the graph store rather than read back from the receipt
the rendered subject corresponds to the source_digest recorded in the registration receipt
